name: Vantris Energy Berhad
overview: Vantris Energy Berhad 今年完成出售其在印度合资公司 L&T-Sapura Shipping 的 40% 股权，并解除 PN17 财务困境状态。公司未公告新的工程、钻井或勘探生产合约，业务板块层面除上述退出外无其他扩张或缩减动作。
overview_en: Vantris Energy Berhad completed the disposal of its 40% equity interest in Indian joint venture L&T-Sapura Shipping this year and uplifted its PN17 status. No new engineering, drilling or exploration & production contracts were announced, and apart from the above exit there were no other expansion or reduction actions at the business segment level.
